facts.text: The watch notice names three keepers. Only Ivy's name is not struck through.
Ivy gave you the watch key and told you to read the notice before deciding about the cistern.
Ivy told you about her brother, the last keeper, and pressed a vial into your hand.
The cistern below the yard is quiet. The lamp above is still waiting.

questions.text: Why is only Ivy's name left on the watch notice?
